biography: Leandro Becker, a name now synonymous with Brazilian motorsport grit, didn't come from racing royalty. Born in the shadow of Interlagos to a family who ran a small auto repair shop, Leandro spent his childhood inhaling the fumes of gasoline and dreaming of roaring engines. His first taste of competition came not in a kart, but in illegal street races, honing his reflexes and developing a fearless edge. Recognizing his raw talent, a local mechanic, Seu Jorge, scraped together enough money to get Leandro into a regional karting series. It was there, at 16, that he caught the eye of Puma GTE scouts. Now, at 29, Leandro is in his peak, battling for championship points and proving that passion and talent can overcome any obstacle. His recent podium finish at the Rio Grand Prix cemented his status as a force to be reckoned with.
drivingStyle: Leandro's driving style is a fascinating blend of aggression and calculation. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, often pushing his car to the very limit of adhesion. However, beneath the surface lies a meticulous planner. He studies telemetry data obsessively, analyzing every corner and braking point to find even the slightest advantage. His tire management is exceptional, often nursing his tires through the final laps while his competitors are struggling for grip. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest.

rivalries.name: Marco Silva
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days, Marco and Leandro have always been neck-and-neck, often clashing on track due to aggressive defending.

rivalries.name: Isabella Rossi
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle for position during the 2022 Interlagos Grand Prix resulted in a controversial collision, fueling a heated rivalry that continues to this day.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A clash of styles, Kenji's smooth, calculated approach often clashes with Leandro's aggressive, unpredictable driving, leading to frequent on-track confrontations.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, given to him by his grandmother before his first race.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba song before every race to calm his nerves.
Always circles his car three times counter-clockwise before getting in.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed, it's about heart. It's about pushing yourself beyond what you think is possible and never giving up, even when the odds are stacked against you."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2021 Brazilian National Championship after a nail-biting final race, overcoming mechanical issues and a late-race safety car to secure the title.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 2020 Interlagos Grand Prix due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential home victory and significant championship points.
